about.text:
#FREE WEEKDAY BREAKFAST & BI-WEEKLY ROOM CLEANS#

Chapter Lewisham is a student accommodation in London, located at 46 Thurston Road. 46 Thurston Road, London SE13 7SD, United Kingdom. Chapter Lewisham student residence offers Studios, En-suites, and Apartments to students in the South East London area of Lewisham. It is steps away from vibrant New Cross, tranquil Blackheath, and Greenwich, where you can experience bustling nightlife in these areas. All our designs and facilities are in place to give you a home away from home. Chapter Lewisham student accommodation offers free weekday breakfast service and bi-weekly room cleans, ensuring a hassle-free stay. Gym, comfortable social and study areas, laundry room, and bicycle storage are at your disposal to enhance your quality of life. Located in Zone 2, the property is also in proximity to Goldsmith University and Greenwich University, making it convenient for students to commute.

What's Included in Chapter Lewisham Student Accommodation?

Chapter Lewisham student accommodation offers various room options to students, from Bronze En-suites and Silver Studios to 3-bed Apartments. Choose your vibe according to your preference and budget. Each room comes with compact double bed, study desk, ample storage, bathroom, and kitchen. Chapter Lewisham student residence covers all utility bills and super-speed Wi-Fi, ensuring a worry-free stay. Our student accommodation also offers many modern amenities to students, such as a gym, a study space, a courtyard, and a games area. Every day feels like a blend of comfort and convenience. 

  • On-site gym: Sweat it out with top-tier Technogym gear and free weights
  • Study spaces: Help you find your focus
  • Games area: Unwind and connect in our social games zone
  • Courtyard: Picnic with friends
  • On-site laundry: Wash the clothes via the My Chapter app
  • Free weekday breakfast service: Snag pastries, fruit, and coffee on busy mornings
  • Free bi-weekly room cleans: Tidy your space

What's Nearby Chapter Lewisham London?

Chapter Lewisham accommodation is located in the London area of Lewisham. Living here, you are close to all of the action, from top universities to restaurants and supermarkets.

1. Nearby Universities:

Chapter Lewisham student accommodation is within easy reach of many famous institutions, like University of Greenwich, Goldsmiths University of London, and King's College London.

  • Goldsmiths, University of London: 12 minutes by bus
  • Oxford International Education Group: 16 minutes by bus
  • University of Greenwich: 17 minutes by train
  • University of Sunderland London Campus: 18 minutes by train
  • King's College London (KCL): 26 minutes by train
  • London School of Economics (LSE): 37 minutes by tube
  • University College London (UCL): 45 minutes by train

2. City Highlights:

Chapter Lewisham London is close to plenty of popular restaurants, trendy bars, shopping centres, and cultural attractions.

  • Bar Beach Grill: Enjoy great cocktails and chicken wings right nearby
  • Sweet1ne Restaurant & Lounge: Taste authentic Caribbean flavours like Rasta Pasta and Seafood Boil within 0.2 miles
  • New Cross Inn: Admire live music performances, 13 minutes away by bus
  • Lewisham Shopping Centre: Go on a shopping spree, 16 minutes away on foot
  • Greenwich Park & Royal Observatory: Take a stroll after dinner with a 30-minute bus ride
  • O2 Arena & Tower Bridge: Explore the charm of this historic and cultural city, with 30—40 minutes away by train or bus

How Can You Commute from Chapter Lewisham London?

Chapter Lewisham London is located in transit-rich Zone 2. Getting around is a breeze for residents in Chapter Lewisham, London, with multiple transport stations close by. Lewisham and St John's Train Stations are just at the doorstep of our Lewisham student housing. The other transport options close by include:

  • Lewisham Train Station: 1 minute on foot
  • St John's Train Station: 2 minutes on foot
  • Thurston Road Bus Stop: 1 minute on foot
  • Jerrard Street Bus Stop: 1 minute on foot
  • Loampit Vale Bus Stop: 2 minutes on foot

What Services & Security Are Provided in Chapter Lewisham Accommodation?

Chapter Lewisham residence always puts students' safety and comfort first. It has various practical services to increase your happiness.

  • Free weekday breakfast service: Fuel your day without the cost
  • Free bi-weekly room cleans: Enjoy a consistently clean space without the chores
  • Short stay options: Adapt to your schedule
  • Vlogger tour: See real rooms before you book
  • On-site team: Always ready to help—from parcel collection to maintenance
  • Video surveillance: Sleep easy
  • Parcel collection: Securely hold packages

Why Choose Chapter Lewisham Student Residence?

Chapter Lewisham is a modern student residence in London designed for comfort and convenience. Here's what makes it popular among students.

  • Prime location in South East London of Zone 2
  • Proximity to popular areas, such as New Cross, Blackheath, and Greenwich
  • Multiple room options, including Studios, En-suites, and Apartments
  • Warm-hearted services, like free weekday breakfast and bi-weekly cleaning
  • Top amenities, like study spaces, games areas, a courtyard, and TV snug
  • Utility bills and super-fast Wi-Fi included

How to Book a Room at Chapter Lewisham Student Accommodation?

Booking a room at Chapter Lewisham student accommodation is simple and convenient. Only through 3 steps can you finish the whole process.

  • Choose your favourite room at Chapter Lewisham student residence and check its availability, price, and tenancy.
  • Reserve an in-person or virtual room tour if needed.
  • Contact our property manager and complete the booking online.

policy_text.text:
Cancellation Policy

To secure your Room prior to 31st July, you must do the following within 3 days of receipt of this Tenancy Agreement (these 3 days being known as the "Decision Making Period"):

1. Pay your Holding Fee (which will be deducted off your first instalment of Rent if your booking is not cancelled).

2. Both the Tenant and the Guarantor must sign the Tenancy Agreement.

If you have not paid the first instalment of Rent on the date of booking, this must be paid on or before 31 July, otherwise, we reserve the right to cancel your booking.

For bookings made after 31st July, to secure your Room you must do the following within the Decision Making Period:

1. Pay your first instalment of Rent.

2. Both the Tenant and the Guarantor must sign the Tenancy Agreement.

A Holding Fee will not be required for bookings made on or after 1st August.

Failure to secure your Room within the required timescales may result in the cancellation of your booking by us.

Cancelling within the Decision Making Period

The Holding Fee is refundable if you provide us with notice of your intention to cancel within the Decision Making Period. If you cancel your booking after the Decision Making Period but prior to 31st July, any advance payment of Rent will be refunded to you less your Holding Fee, which will not be refunded.

Taking no action throughout the Decision Making Period

If at the end of the Decision Making Period you have taken no action, i.e. not signed and accepted your Tenancy Agreement and/or not paid your Holding Fee and/or your first instalment of Rent then your offer will be cancelled on our system and your Room will be made available for someone else to book.

Cancelling on or after 1 August after accepting your Tenancy Agreement and having paid your first instalment of Rent

To request to cancel your booking outside of the Decision Making Period on or after 31st July but prior to the Tenancy Start Date as set out in the Tenancy Agreement, you must meet any of the following criteria:

1. Your application for a visa has been declined. Please note that this does not include situations where your visa has been granted and subsequently withdrawn.

2. You have failed to obtain your grades to study at university and as such do not have student status.

(the "Cancellation Criteria")

If you meet any of the above Cancellation Criteria and can provide us with evidence demonstrating that you meet the above criteria, your request for cancellation will be granted. If you have already accepted your Tenancy Agreement and paid your first instalment of Rent at the date your cancellation request is granted, we will refund you the first instalment of Rent less any Holding Fee paid (or an amount equivalent to the Holding Fee if you booked your room after 31st July).

If you need to cancel your booking outside of the Decision Making Period on or after 31st July but prior to the Tenancy Start Date as set out in the Tenancy Agreement after accepting your Tenancy Agreement and having paid your first instalment of Rent but cannot meet the above Cancellation Criteria you will remain liable in full for the Rent for the full term of the Tenancy Agreement. This is unless a suitable replacement tenant can be found by you, acceptance of which will be at our sole discretion. Please note that we will not agree to a replacement tenant unless all outstanding accounts with us are settled.

Any decision made to release you from your Tenancy Agreement for any reason that does not fall within the Cancellation Criteria is made by us, at our sole discretion on a case by case basis.

After the Tenancy Start Date as set out in the Tenancy Agreement, requests for room moves or for us to accept a replacement tenant to take over you tenancy will be managed based on availability and at our sole discretion. An Administration Fee of £50 will be payable in each instance if agreed to by us and you will be responsible for cleaning the room in accordance with the terms of the Tenancy Agreement.

Requests for replacement tenants received after 1 June within the Tenancy Period will not be accepted.
